verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a sandbox environment or any test customers, personas, or magic values that deterministically produce no-hit, hit, or review screening outcomes. The Postman collection, OpenAPI schema, and webhook result fields are integration aids, not a deterministic test-outcome capability.

support.subject: As a developer, a sandbox lets me exercise every outcome before going live — documented test documents, personas, or magic values that deterministically produce pass, fail, and review results
